title: The Bible / canonical books
authority: Church-hosted account citing Holy Synod 1983 and Ethiopian Orthodox Mission 1970 publications
finding: The page presents Scripture and apostolic tradition together and enumerates 46 Old Testament and 35 New Testament book units. Its broad statement attributing both Testaments to the Septuagint must not be used as a precise translation genealogy: the Septuagint is an Old Testament corpus.
limit: Website hosting is not verification of each historical assertion or uniform book divisions across editions.

title: The Lord is a Good Shepherd
authority: Ledeta LeMariam Sunday School / Alexandria Virginia; church-hosted teaching
use: Primary Ethiopian Orthodox teaching for first study; parish teaching scope
finding: Lesson connects the shepherd's care with Christ; food and drink with His body and blood; staff with the Cross against the devil. These are the lesson's Christian interpretations. Its English Bible quotation has no edition named.
limit: Not a synodal decree or a recovered verse-level Andemta edition; unnamed English quotation is not adopted as the study's base translation.

title: The Liturgy of the Ethiopian Church
authority: Ethiopian Orthodox Church Kingston reprint; introduction by Archbishop Yesehaq
date: 1959 publication / 1991 reprint / 2006 re-edit per front matter
use: Liturgical context and explicit translator attribution
finding: Front matter names translator Marcos Daoud and reviser Blatta Marsie Hazen. Yesehaq's introduction places Eucharistic communal worship at the center of church life.
limit: Liturgical translation is not a complete biblical translation or a word-for-word Ge'ez witness.

title: The Early Translation of the Bible into Ethiopic/Geez
authority: G. A. Mikre-Sellassie / Ethiopian translation consultant / scholarly historical discussion
use: Secondary historical context only; not replacement biblical commentary
finding: Discusses conflicting traditional accounts and uncertainty over the exact dating and translators of the Ethiopic Bible. A proposed translation chronology must be attributed rather than treated as a dated manuscript observation.
limit: Historical article from 2000; do not promote its older manuscript-age assertions to a current earliest-manuscript finding.

title: Psalms Chapter 23 / Hebrew text
authority: Mechon-Mamre digital Hebrew textual edition; supplementary language witness
language: Hebrew; adjacent English excluded from study base
use: Original-language wording check only; not interpretive authority
finding: Hebrew heading associates the psalm with David; verse 1 contains יהוה רעי and verse 4 addresses God directly. A modern edition is a textual witness rather than an autograph.
limit: No Ge'ez collation follows from reading Hebrew; site's English rendering is not adopted.

title: Preserving the lay bet andemta / EAP336
authority: British Library Endangered Archives Programme; archival access lead
language: Catalogue / manuscript languages not inspected here
finding: Direct retrieval returned a JavaScript verification challenge.
limit: No manuscript image or verse-level commentary verified.

title: MWI010 / EAP336/6/10 / Andemta Dawit
authority: Beta maṣāḥəft manuscript catalogue; discovery lead
finding: Search identifies a Psalms commentary record; direct page retrieval failed with 502.
limit: Catalogue discovery does not establish its Psalm 23 folio wording or interpretation.

title: The Good Shepherd LORD Jesus Christ and His Sheep
authority: Mahibere Kidusan page with external sermon attribution
use: Provenance counterexample; excluded as primary Ethiopian exegesis
finding: The page credits Saint George Greek Orthodox Church and a sermon of Saint Ignatius. Its closing reference labels a blind-man exchange John 10:35–38 while its preceding narrative names chapter 9.
limit: Do not silently relabel imported sermon content as Ethiopian-origin Andemta or reuse the inconsistent verse reference.
